name: congress
description: Number of the Congress, e.g. 115 for the 115th Congress (2017-2019)
observations: Ordinal Congress number, starting at 1 in 1789. Each Congress spans two years. Partition column of the partitioned tables

name: rollnumber
description: Sequential number of the roll call within the Congress and chamber
observations: Starts at 1 in the first roll call of each Congress. Excludes quorum calls and vacated votes, so it does not match clerk_rollnumber. Stored as text: cast to INT64 to sort numerically

name: session
description: Session of the Congress in which the roll call took place
observations: Empty for most historical roll calls

name: clerk_rollnumber
description: Roll call number assigned by the clerk of the chamber
observations: Includes quorum calls and vacated votes and restarts at 1 every session, not every Congress

name: majority_requirement
description: Fraction of votes required to pass, e.g. 1/2, 2/3 or 3/5

name: nominate_mid_1
description: NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) first-dimension midpoint estimate of the roll call

name: nominate_mid_2
description: NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) second-dimension midpoint estimate of the roll call

name: nominate_spread_1
description: NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) first-dimension spread estimate of the roll call

name: nominate_spread_2
description: NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) second-dimension spread estimate of the roll call

name: nominate_log_likelihood
description: Log-likelihood of the roll call's NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) estimate

name: bill_number
description: Number of the bill on which the roll call was held

name: vote_result
description: Official result of the roll call

name: vote_desc
description: Description of the roll call assigned by congressional staff

name: vote_question
description: Question put to the vote, e.g. On Agreeing to the Amendment

name: dtl_desc
description: Description of the roll call from historical sources
